title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
summary: SAME-R studied smoke particles from five spacecraft materials heated below ignition in ISS microgravity under varied inlet velocities, heater settings and aerosol aging times. These are smoke-generation and detector measurements, not flammability-limit tests; the 109 records include 67 primary runs and 42 secondary aging observations documented in the final report.
